description:
The biggest DLC in the history of the series drops on 24 September! Four Lords of the End Times join the roster of Legendary Lords, alongside a vast array of new units, new scenarios, gameplay updates, and revised victory conditions.

Plus, for the first time in series history, purchasing the Lords of the End Times DLC – either a singular character or the whole bundle at once – will grant you immediate access to the epic, world-spanning Immortal Empires game mode without the need to own any prior Total War: Warhammer game.

Get all the info here: https://ow.ly/UCNm50ZzpHQ 

Pre-order now: https://ow.ly/ycvh50ZzpFF
